_readme: Illustrative test cases for the TEXT-ONLY diagnosis path (Groq/Claude fallback). Cross-check expected_disease labels against a plant pathology reference or agriculture extension resource before quoting numbers publicly. For the IMAGE path (Gemini Vision), you'll need a separate labeled image folder -- see disease_image_eval_notes.md.

cases.symptom_text: Brown concentric ring spots on older leaves, leaves turning yellow and falling off
White powdery coating on leaf undersides, leaves curling upward
Diamond-shaped grey lesions with brown borders on leaves
Orange-brown pustules on leaf surface that rub off as powder
Dark water-soaked patches on leaves spreading rapidly in humid weather
Yellowing of leaf veins with leaf curling and stunted plant growth
Long red streaks on leaves turning into rotting stalks with alcohol smell
Purple-brown lesions on leaf tips spreading down the leaf
Small dark brown circular spots on leaves surrounded by yellow halo
Small reddish-brown pustules on the underside of leaves
Wilting of entire plant starting from lower leaves, roots show black discoloration
Long cigar-shaped grey-green lesions on leaves
White rust-like pustules on leaf undersides with yellow patches on top
Grey mold growth on flower head in wet conditions, head rot
Yellow streaking on leaves, stunted bulb growth
Sunken dark lesions on fruit with concentric rings
Yellowing and drying of leaf tips starting from margins, wavy lesion edges
Small dark scab-like lesions on tuber skin
Angular water-soaked lesions on leaves turning dark brown along veins
Black powdery masses replacing grain in the ear head
